mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, C.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, P.NAME, P.BRAND, P.PRICE, P.SALE_PRICE, P.STOCK, P.STATUS, P.WIDTH_CM, P.DEPTH_CM, P.HEIGHT_CM, P.WEIGHT_KG, P.SHIPPING_FEE, P.DESCRIPTION_HTML FROM PRODUCTS P JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL
SELECT PRODUCT_OPTION_ID, OPTION_TYPE, OPTION_VALUE, ADDITIONAL_PRICE, STOCK FROM PRODUCT_OPTIONS WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY PRODUCT_OPTION_ID ASC
SELECT CATEGORY_ID, PARENT_ID, NAME, DEPTH, SORT_ORDER FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORIES ORDER BY DEPTH ASC, SORT_ORDER ASC, CATEGORY_ID ASC
SELECT STOCK FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCTS SET STOCK = STOCK - #{quantity} WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND STOCK >= #{quantity}
UPDATE PRODUCT_OPTIONS SET STOCK = STOCK - #{quantity} WHERE PRODUCT_OPTION_ID = #{productOptionId} AND STOCK >= #{quantity}
UPDATE PRODUCTS SET STOCK = STOCK + #{quantity} WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
UPDATE PRODUCT_OPTIONS SET STOCK = STOCK + #{quantity} WHERE PRODUCT_OPTION_ID = #{productOptionId}
